response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack engineer with a strong web/backend background (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) and solid engineering practices, but the profile does not match the core requirements of this embedded networking security role. There is no evidence of native-level Japanese proficiency (languages listed are English, Romanian, basic German), no Linux kernel analysis or source modification experience, and no security, L2/L3 networking, switch chip, or firmware development background. C experience is limited to a short stint at National Instruments roughly a decade ago, whereas the role requires strong current C proficiency for UNIX development. The gap is on hard, non-negotiable requirements rather than nice-to-haves.
strengths: 10+ years of professional software development experience across many domains
Some C/C++ exposure (National Instruments IDE components, C++ audio/Linux thesis project)
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps, open-source tooling authorship
concerns: No Japanese language ability; role requires native-level proficiency
No Linux kernel, embedded firmware, or switch/networking security experience
C skills are dated and peripheral; recent work is web/cloud in TypeScript

key_factors.factor: Weak, outdated C proficiency for UNIX development
